subject: how to make a methylRawList from a methylBase object

messages.author: b5b1db21b60ddd4a
messages.subject: how to make a methylRawList from a methylBase object
parts:
I recently posted a message about error for region counts Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable), and was given a more correct way to make a new file using “reorganize”. 

 

However I was able to make region data without errors, but could not progress onto making “getMethylationStats” I got the error message:

 

> getMethylationStats(Tss500ox[[1]],plot=T,both.strands=F)

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :

  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘getMethylationStats’ for signature ‘"factor"’

> head(Tss500ox[[1]])

[1] chr1 chr1 chr1 chr1 chr1 chr1

25 Levels: chr1 chr2 chr3 chr4 chr5 chr6 chr7 chr8 chr9 chrM chrX ... chr22

 

This is a strange output for head, but then I realised that I previously made a methylBase object and then tried to reorganise it treating it as if it were a methylRawList.

 

How can you deconstruct a methylBase object (In my case containing 4 files) into two separate methylRawLists?  I want the output to be methylRawLists so that I can do regional analysis for promoters and CGIs, something which you cannot do a methylBase object.

 

Michelle
